## The blog

In this blog, I write about topics ranging from machine learning
to mathematical physics.

## The author

I'm a mathematician and machine learning engineer.
I received my Ph.D. in mathematics from the University of Bergen;
before that, I studied quantum field theory at
Saint Petersburg State University.
I'm particularly interested in the connections between
information theory and theoretical physics.

## The website

This website is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org).
If you notice a technical problem with the site, please report it in
[this discussion thread](https://github.com/alexeytochin/alexeytochin.github.io/discussions/3).
